prompts: The model configs our coding harnesses use are in {WS}: OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code each get one. They disagree about the context window of fast-coder: OpenCode's config says 262144, the other two say 131072. 262144 is the right value. Make all three agree, for good. Every other model setting stays as it is.
answers:
All three configs now give fast-coder a context window of 262144.

**What was wrong:** the three files in `out/` are generated by `gen.py` from one source file, `models.json`. That source said 131072. The Codex and Claude Code configs matched it. OpenCode's config said 262144, so someone had probably edited it by hand. If I had only edited the two output files, the next run of `gen.py` would have put 131072 back everywhere, OpenCode included.

**What I changed:** I set fast-coder's context window in `models.json` to 262144 and ran `python gen.py` to regenerate all three files. Because the source now has the right value, rerunning the generator won't undo the fix.

**How I know it's right:** I compared `out/` before and after regenerating. The only differences are the two context-window lines, in `claude.json` and `codex.toml`, which went from 131072 to 262144. `opencode.json` came out byte-for-byte the same, which also shows its only difference from the source was this value. No other model settings changed.

**Assumption:** the install step copies these files from `out/` into each harness, as the README says. I didn't touch any copies already installed on the machine, so they'll pick up the change the next time that step runs.

    {"name": "tiny-chat", "context_window": 32768, "max_output": 4096, "tool_calling": false}
